_comment: A day folder's design stamp, as postroll/media/design_stamp.py actually
The 'templates' object below is NOT hand-written. tests/
test_media_design_version.py asserts it is exactly what write_design_stamp
produces today, so it cannot be shaped to make either side's test pass and
cannot drift when a design version is bumped: the bump fails that
assertion until this file is regenerated.
That matters because the Swift side's other tests build their own JSON,
and a fake you wrote can only ever confirm your own assumption about the
real format. This is the one case where Swift reads a file Python made.
Keyed by the filename stem the generator writes into a day folder. A
missing entry means that asset was rendered before the stamp existed, and
reads as older rather than as current.
